usage.chartAriaLabel: {{period}} token usage over time, {{bins}} buckets, peak {{peakAt}} at {{peakValue}} tokens. Use arrow keys to step through, Esc to dismiss.
usage.breakdownNote: Cache / video / audio are all subsets of "input" and are not counted separately in the total; cache hit rate = cache / input.
usage.noKeyWarning: ⚠️ No active model (not configured or not enabled) — the perception engine isn't running and won't produce usage.
usage.emptyProfiles: No active model — perception is stopped. Use "＋ Add" below to configure and enable one.
usage.addFormHint: Add model config (if the same Model + Base URL exists, its Key will be updated)
usage.editFormHint: Edit model config (leave API Key blank to keep the existing one)
usage.apiKeyPlaceholderExisting: Leave blank to keep current API key
usage.apiKeyCurrentHint: Currently {{masked}} — leave blank to keep it
usage.modelComboPlaceholder: Select or type a model id (e.g. mimo-v2.5)
usage.modelsCount: {{n}} available, search or type directly; please pick a multimodal (omni) model supporting video/audio
usage.modelsHint: Auto-fetched after filling Base URL and API Key, or type a model id directly
usage.baseUrlModelRequired: Base URL and model cannot be empty
usage.apiKeyRequiredBeforeTest: Please enter an API Key before testing
usage.saveSuccess: Saved, click "Enable" in the list to apply
usage.testBadKey: Invalid API key or insufficient permission
usage.testRejectedAuthed: Connected, but the request was rejected (model name or API key may be wrong)
usage.testHttpError: Server returned an error — check the Base URL
usage.testRateLimited: Rate-limited by the provider, please retry later
usage.activateSuccess: Enabled, takes effect next inference cycle
usage.deleteActiveWarning: This is the active model — deleting it stops perception and reverts to an unconfigured state until you configure and enable another model.
usage.modelsEmptyResult: This address returned no model list
usage.timelineEmpty: No usage yet in this period
usage.pricingNote: Estimated locally — not a provider invoice. Prices are saved per model name; usage records only store the model name, so the same model served from different Base URLs cannot be priced separately.
usage.pricingCacheWarn: Cache-hit price is not below the input price. Cache is {{share}}% of input this period, so if your provider discounts hits and this does not, the estimate is about {{pct}}% too high.
usage.pricingPreview: Estimated total for this period ({{tokens}} tokens)
usage.pricingNoModels: No usage yet this period — nothing to price until the engine runs.
usage.costHelp: Estimated locally from each model's prices — not a provider invoice. Cache hits are priced at the discounted rate; per-modality pricing uses the input minus video minus audio residual, so video and audio are not billed twice.
usage.clearDialogBody: This deletes all token usage records (live table + daily rollup).
usage.clearDialogWarn: Cannot be undone — history is unrecoverable.
usage.pricingPresetHint: Pre-filled from the provider's public price list; you can override it.
